text:
Maya R: Need quick alignment on retention wording for pilot. Legal wants precise phrasing for auditors and a clear legal-hold behavior.
Jordan P: Draft copy: "Default retention: operational logs retained 3 years (auto-tier). Cryptographic proofs and keystore attestations retained 7 years in tamper-evident bundles. Legal hold prevents deletion and export until released." Thoughts?
Ina (Legal): Good start. Change: say "tamper-evident bundles signed with Redwood custody key and timestamped (NTP)." Also add: "Customers may request extended retention under enterprise agreements."
Kevin: Ops note: we'll need legal-hold flag that is global and an export-before-purge path for proofs. Estimate: 5 dev-days for flag+export spike.
Maya R: Action: Jordan update PRD with Ina's wording + Kevin start spike. Target: PRD by Wed, spike demo next week.
Jordan P: On it. Will post PRD link here when done.
Ina (Legal): I'll review and sign off once PRD includes signature algo and custody stamp process.
